integrity.claim_scope: Stationarity, uniqueness and exponential depth moments only on dyadics
integrity.computer_assistance: Exact rational finite-prefix and finite-state consistency checks only
integrity.proof: Exact prefix certificate and countable-state analytical recurrence argument

scientific_limitations: Sufficient parameter interval, not a sharp recurrence threshold; stationary on the dyadic state space only, with no physicality or global circle uniqueness claim.
title: Atomic stationary laws without pointwise average expansion in a random dyadic circle system
